fact: The National Health Strategic Plan 2022-2026 (revised February 2023) names the Health Management Information System among the health information subsystems coordinated within the Ministry of Health, says it was strengthened during 2017 to 2021, and sets strategies to strengthen and integrate the HMIS, district HMIS and community HMIS; it also records the lack of HMIS standard operating procedures at all levels.
title: National Health Stratergic Plan for Zambia 2022 to 2026 revised February 2023
publisher: Ministry of Health, Republic of Zambia
